name: block_into_cup
success_definition: Block remains inside the cup after the gripper releases it and withdraws.
reset: Operator-clicked DROID joint Home after Finish; manually replace objects; no automatic gripper movement.
pilot_placement: fixed cup and fixed block start position for the first two or three episodes
later_demonstration_placement: keep cup fixed; introduce small block position and orientation changes only after pilot review
trial_goal: three short pilot episodes; inspect image visibility, timestamps, and labels before collecting a full demonstration set
